headline: Alphabet Market Value Drops by $500 Billion Amid AI Search Concerns
summary: Google's market value fell by $500 billion, hitting a six-month low after the company revealed that AI search summaries impacted its ad revenue.
why: Alphabet is one of the world's largest technology conglomerates and a dominant player in digital advertising and search, making changes to its monetization model critical for sector valuations.

impacts.name: Alphabet Inc.
impacts.why: Concerns over ad revenue impact from AI search summaries drove the stock to a six-month low.

why_moved: Disappointment over ad revenue impacts from new AI search features triggered a massive sell-off among investors concerned about the core monetization model.
